# ⚓️ TO THE END • WINDFARER ⚓️
A Minecraft Server with flyable Custom Airship Combat with No Mods! Available for both Java and Bedrock edition!

![Serverlobbyphoto](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/VXitTHLd/images/17a94193a330a3f7238028dfeb9a0cb06db7f588.png)
## Custom Airships, Vehicles, Ships, and Planes!
Build and fly your own block based creations with the Windfarer plugin!  

## Airship Combat
Variety of weapons and armor options with balanced combat mechanics to battle other creations! TNT Cannons, Rockets, Machine Guns, Torpedoes, and More! 

![torpedoattack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8bebb5db7965b09599f118b7e768e161625afb3.gif)
## TNT Cannons
This server has a significant TNT cannon community testing the limits of Minecraft redstone combat engineering! 

## Campaign Mode
An upcoming gamemode in which two factions wage an ongoing war over a map with their creations!  

### Both JAVA and BEDROCK support through Geyser!
